description: This source file defines the class ValueTypeDescriptor, which is a descriptor for various value types within the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel.Internals namespace. It provides methods for getting, setting, and checking null status of value properties related to DocumentObject instances.

classes.name: ValueTypeDescriptor
classes.description: A class that extends ValueDescriptor, providing mechanisms to interact with value types within DocumentObject instances, including getting, setting, and null checks.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of the property from a DocumentObject, creating it if necessary based on flags.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets the property value of a DocumentObject.

methods.name: SetNull
methods.description: Sets the property value to null, effectively marking it as null.

methods.name: IsNull
methods.description: Checks if the property value in a DocumentObject is null.
